definitions.gloss: to go bar-hopping; to go from bar to bar; to drink at various places
definitions.explanation: To visit multiple bars, pubs, or drinking establishments in one outing, having drinks at each. A compound verb from {飲|の}む (to drink) + {歩|ある}く (to walk around).

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{飲|の}み{歩|ある}いた。
examples.english: I went bar-hopping with friends on the weekend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新宿|しんじゅく}→新宿：30634_shinjuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{居酒屋|いざかや}→居酒屋：09635_izakaya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飲|の}み{歩|ある}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: I like going around to different izakaya in Shinjuku.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出張先|しゅっちょうさき}→出張先：27265_shucchousaki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{案内|あんない}して→案内する：20203_annaisuru⟧⟦もらい→もらう：00520_morau⟧、⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飲|の}み{歩|ある}いた。
examples.english: A local showed me around on my business trip, and we went drinking from place to place in the nightlife district.

notes:
A compound verb: ⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ (to drink) + ⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧ (to walk around). The ～⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧ pattern means 'to go around doing something' and appears in other compounds like ⟦{食|た}べ{歩|ある}く→食べ歩く：20274_tabearuku⟧ (to eat at various places) and {探|さが}し{歩|ある}く (to search around).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飲|の}み{歩|ある}く — to go drinking around town
- ⟦{居酒屋|いざかや}→居酒屋：09635_izakaya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飲|の}み{歩|ある}く — to bar-hop at izakaya
- {飲|の}み{歩|ある}き⟦ツアー→ツアー：08285_tsuaa⟧ — a drinking tour, pub crawl

SIMILAR WORDS:
- はしご{酒|ざけ} — bar-hopping (noun; literally 'ladder drinking')
- ⟦{食|た}べ{歩|ある}く→食べ歩く：20274_tabearuku⟧ — to eat at various places (same ～⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧ pattern with food)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Bar-hopping is a popular social activity in Japan, especially in entertainment districts like ⟦{新宿|しんじゅく}→新宿：30634_shinjuku⟧, ⟦{渋谷|しぶや}→渋谷：30632_shibuya⟧, and {中洲|なかす}. The typical pattern is to visit 2-3 small establishments in an evening.
